findings.friction_name: signup CTA hidden below the fold on the pricing page
findings.narrative: The persona could not locate the primary CTA without scrolling; two extra scroll actions were needed.

findings.friction_name: plan names do not state what happens after the trial, and the ambiguity now blocks the trial-to-paid conversion path entirely

severity_factors.impact: persona abandons checkout, believing the trial silently converts to a paid plan

findings.narrative: The buyer persona could not resolve what 'flexible billing' means even after opening the FAQ, and abandoned the checkout rather than risk an unexpected charge — the SAME finding_id as findings-valid.json's fid-plan-names-ambiguous, but reproduced this run at severity 4 (catastrophic) instead of the baseline's severity 2. Per F151/CR3-6, a finding_id match to a baseline entry does not exempt a genuine severity escalation from the F26 CI gate — 'already-known finding_id' is not the same as 'already-known severity'.
